sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, AVG(yt) as avg_yt_per_trip FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 170 AND 200 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy LIMIT 50;
SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, AVG(yt) as avg_yt_per_trip FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 280 AND 310 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy LIMIT 50;
